text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute didn't show up for training, 
so while searching for her, I spotted her 
crafting something in a classroom...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm thinking of giving beaded 
keychains to my classmates as presents, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told the bewildered Wonder Acute that 
our training time had already passed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're just saying that, it's gotta be a 
prank— Oh my, the sun really is setting 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Once I focus, I lose sight of 
my surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed genuinely remorseful, so I 
simply warned her to be more careful in 
the future.
